# That’s What She Synced

> A free, open-source Dynamic Island for MacBooks with a notch, themed on The Office (US). It is an unofficial fan project built on the Vorssaint macOS app: the notch takes the album cover’s colours, moves with the beat, shows original dancers and an Office-style companion beside the camera, gives Claude Code and Codex a wing while they work, and shows Office-style alerts.

Not made by or linked to Vorssaint, NBCUniversal or The Office. Licensed GPL-3.0-or-later. No app builds are distributed: you build it from source on your own Mac.

## Facts

- Needs: an Apple silicon Mac on macOS 14.4 or later, and Apple’s Command Line Tools
- Music: Apple Music, Spotify, and music playing in Safari, Chrome or Firefox
- Install: clone the repository, then run `VORSSAINT_DEV_OPTIMIZE=1 ./build.sh --dev --install`
- Settings: Settings › Dynamic Island › Activity › That’s What She Synced
- Turn every extra off: tap the mug at the end of the island’s bottom row
- Battery: the dancers and the glow rest while the island is hidden or the Mac is in Low Power Mode
